_added_after_the_download._label: ADDED AFTER THE DOWNLOAD, 2026-09-19. Everything above this block was committed before hotels.csv existed on this machine; nothing in this block was. It is kept apart so a reader can tell the two apart at a glance, which is the only thing the pre-registration is worth.
_added_after_the_download._walk_cost_share: Multiple of base_rate, because a walk cost cannot be derived from booking history: it is a room bought at a competitor at short notice, the transport there, and the goodwill afterwards. The simulated hotel's 620 against its 189 base rate is 3.28, so 3.0 is the same order and the more conservative of the two.
_added_after_the_download._max_overbook_pct: Also not in booking history. The simulated hotel authorises 6 percent above its stated room count; the pilot authorises 5, because its room count is inferred from the busiest observed night and is biased low by construction, so every authorised room already sits on a floor rather than on a true ceiling.
_added_after_the_download._gross_demand_excludes_every_nonrev_bran: A change to a derivation that was pre-registered, so it is recorded here. The month ranking behind demand_season_band is by gross demand; the code excluded the COMP branch from it but counted the ADR0 branch, although both map to the NONREV target. Gross demand means demand, so both are now out. Direction: it moved no band at either hotel. It removes 131 room nights from H1's warm-up window of about 67,100 and 254 from H2's of about 72,100, no month changed rank across a band boundary, and the twelve labels of each hotel are the same before and after. Recorded because a pre-registered derivation must not change quietly, not because a number moved.
